card.name: The word set in IV tubing
card.fires_on: The word "set" or "sets" meaning IV tubing, right after "administration", "IV" or "intravenous". It appears in infusion and administration instructions.

modes.label: Administration set
modes.description: "set" or "sets" after "administration" in warnings about blood products or lipid lines.
modes.example: Do not administer Mannitol Injection simultaneously with blood products through the same administration<< set>> because of the possibility of pseudoaggl

modes.label: IV set
modes.description: "set" after "IV" or "intravenous" in steps for attaching tubing to a container.
modes.example: Prior to attaching the IV<< set>>, check for minute leaks by squeezing container
